bindings.rationale: Expected T1 and T2 with filtered total 2. Both assertions passed for lowercase tools.
Tools has no exact category in the offered catalog. Expected filtered total 0; the service check observed 0.
Expected the selected tools view to be on page 1. Starting at page 1, the view remained on page 1 and the test returned the expected tools IDs.
Expected view.page to be 1 after selecting tools from books page 3. The reported assertion found 3.
Expected the API call to receive ('tools', 1, 2). The recorded call instead received ('tools', 3, 2).
Expected both identical tools requests to return T1 and T2 with one cache entry. Those assertions passed.
Expected books page 1 size 2 to return B1,B2, page 2 size 2 to return B3,B4, and page 1 size 1 to return B1. All three checks passed.
After caching books, the tools request at the same page and size should return T1,T2. It returned B1,B2. This establishes the collision on IDs; the failed assertion prevented the later total check.
At service level the expected books page 2 size 2 returned B3,B4 in order. The tools request beyond the end directly returned empty items, total 2 and page 3.

At API level the expected ordered books slices B1,B2 and B3,B4 and the size-1 slice B1 were observed. Out-of-range items and total were checked at service level; the fixed-category API delegation supplies the implementation context for combining those checks.

comparisonContexts.description: Combine the service boundary check with the fixed-category API page/size check. For a fixed category and immutable catalog, a cache miss invokes the service, and a hit reuses the same page/size result. Cross-category reuse is assessed separately.

obligations.description: For one fixed category at a time, preserve catalog order and the maximum page size; return empty items and the filtered total past the final page.

criteria.scopeDescription: Composite fixed-category check: API integration directly covers ordered in-range books pages and two sizes. Service execution directly covers an ordered books slice and the empty tools page with its filtered total. The API delegates cache misses to the service and returns the cached response (artifact-2 L10-L14), linking the two observations for this fixed-category scope. Out-of-range behavior was exercised directly only at service level.

evidenceReviews.rationale: The identified unit check in the offered baseline asserts tools IDs, tools total and the Tools case variant. The execution records a pass for this test.
The identified service unit test passed its books slice assertion and the entire out-of-range tools response assertion.
The identified API test passed two requests on one instance for an identical tools tuple and checked the single cache entry.
The offered integration observation matches the baseline books test varying page and size on one API instance. All three ID assertions passed.
The baseline first-page UI selection passed assertions on resulting category, page, and IDs. Its starting page was already 1.
The identified third-page UI test failed at its first assertion after the selection, reporting retained page 3. The later item assertion was not reached.
The captured tuple in the integration assertion identifies the actual API arguments during selection from page 3.
The second item's list comparison in the two-request check failed on its expected tools IDs. The earlier books assertion completed, and the later total assertion was not reached.

risk.rationale: The synthetic catalog can show a user the wrong category or an empty list after a selection. Shared cache state and the previous UI page both matter. The catalog is public, fixed and local to one process.
